summary: Reserved for end to end encryption. The relay routes it by id without reading data. Never sent in version 1.
planPosition: A later version may move this to a binary WebSocket frame, so the relay does not have to parse JSON to route it.
encoding: One JSON object per WebSocket text frame, UTF-8. Unknown fields are ignored by the receiver.

id.notes: The stream id it belongs to.

data.notes: Base64. The relay never parses it.

valid.name: shape only, never sent in version 1

invalid.name: received in version 1
invalid.expect: error unsupported_frame, because opaque was not agreed in ready
